mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_media_file ( biz_type, storage_type, original_name, stored_name, extension, content_type, file_size, relative_path, access_url ) VALUES ( #{bizType}, #{storageType}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{extension}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{relativePath}, #{accessUrl} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, biz_type AS bizType, storage_type AS storageType, original_name AS originalName, stored_name AS storedName, extension, content_type AS contentType, file_size AS fileSize, relative_path AS relativePath, access_url AS accessUrl, created_at AS createdAt FROM blog_media_file WHERE storage_type = #{storageType} ORDER BY id ASC
